key: It's a vending machine.\nWhich drink would you like? \G
en: It's a vending machine.\nWhich drink would you like? \G
ja: 自動販売機だ。\nどの飲み物にする? \G
\Gおいしいみずが出てきた!
\Gボーナス! おいしいみずがもう一本出てきた。

key: \GYou have no room left in the bag.
en: \GYou have no room left in the bag.
ja: \Gバッグに空きがない。
\Gお金が足りない。
\Gサイコソーダが出てきた!
\Gボーナス! サイコソーダがもう一本出てきた。
\Gミックスオレが出てきた!
\Gボーナス! ミックスオレがもう一本出てきた。
いらっしゃいませ!
……そんな目で見ないでよ。

key: Nurse Joy fled after we took over this city, so they had to get someone else to fill in.
en: Nurse Joy fled after we took over this city, so they had to get someone else to fill in.
ja: この街を制圧したらジョーイさんが逃げちゃって、代わりの人材を用意する羽目になったのよ。

key: But now I'm healing their enemies' Pokémon too!
en: But now I'm healing their enemies' Pokémon too!
ja: でも今じゃ、敵のポケモンまで回復させてやってるわけ!
だから、それがどうしたって話!

key: That's what they get for wasting my talents behind this counter!
en: That's what they get for wasting my talents behind this counter!
ja: あたしの才能をこんなカウンターの裏で腐らせてる連中への、いい仕返しよ!

key: Anyway, would you like to rest your Pokémon or what?
en: Anyway, would you like to rest your Pokémon or what?
ja: とにかく、ポケモンを休ませていく? どうする?

key: Welcome! You get scuffed up again?
en: Welcome! You get scuffed up again?
ja: いらっしゃい! また傷だらけになってきたわけ?

key: All right, I'll take your Pokémon.
en: All right, I'll take your Pokémon.
ja: はいはい、ポケモン預からせてもらうわね。

key: Don't worry, I'll give them back eventually.
en: Don't worry, I'll give them back eventually.
ja: 安心して、ちゃんと返すから。

key: Oh, uh... Your Pokémon may be infected by PokéRus.
en: Oh, uh... Your Pokémon may be infected by PokéRus.
ja: あ、えっと……あなたのポケモン、ポケルスに感染してるかもしれないわね。

key: Little is known about the PokéRus except that they are microscopic lifeforms that attach to Pokémon.
en: Little is known about the PokéRus except that they are microscopic lifeforms that attach to Pokémon.
ja: ポケルスについては、ポケモンに取り付く微小な生物だということ以外、あまり分かっていないの。

key: While infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
en: While infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
ja: 感染している間、ポケモンは驚くほどよく育つと言われているわ。

key: ...At least that's what it says here.
en: ...At least that's what it says here.
ja: ……少なくとも、ここにはそう書いてあるけど。
はい、どうぞ。
で、知ってる?

key: We DON'T hope to see you again!
en: We DON'T hope to see you again!
ja: あんたにまた会いたいなんて、これっぽっちも思ってないから!
そうよ!

key: We hope your Pokémon live happy, healthy lives and never need to be rushed here in critical condition after a battle ever again!
en: We hope your Pokémon live happy, healthy lives and never need to be rushed here in critical condition after a battle ever again!
ja: あんたのポケモンが幸せで健康に暮らして、バトルの後にひん死でここに担ぎ込まれることなんて二度とないよう願ってるわ!
せいぜいクソ楽しい一日を!

key: We hope you never come back.
en: We hope you never come back.
ja: もう二度と来ないでほしいものね。

key: Okay, then what're you even doing here?
en: Okay, then what're you even doing here?
ja: はいはい、それであんた、何しに来たわけ?
うわ、盛大にやらかしたわね?

key: ...Hold up, you just went and blacked out to the first guy you met?
en: ...Hold up, you just went and blacked out to the first guy you met?
ja: ……ちょっと待って、最初に会った相手にあっさり気絶させられたの?
うわぁ、実力不足ってやつね。

key: Maybe try and, y'know, not do that.
en: Maybe try and, y'know, not do that.
ja: そういうの、もうやめといたら?
まあ、思っただけだけど。

key: ...What, don't look at me like that.
en: ...What, don't look at me like that.
ja: ……何よ、そんな目で見ないでよ。
ほら、直してあげる。
はい、これで万全よ。

key: Go do whatever it is you were trying to do, but better this time.
en: Go do whatever it is you were trying to do, but better this time.
ja: 何をしようとしてたのか知らないけど、今度はもうちょっとマシにやりなさいよ。

key: Frankly you'd think more of our guys would be making use of this place...
en: Frankly you'd think more of our guys would be making use of this place...
ja: 正直、うちの連中がもっとここを使ってもよさそうなもんだけど……

key: Guess they're too busy conking out every time they lose.
en: Guess they're too busy conking out every time they lose.
ja: 負けるたびにぶっ倒れるのに忙しいんでしょうね。

key: Seriously, it's amazing this team ever got anywhere.
en: Seriously, it's amazing this team ever got anywhere.
ja: まったく、このチームがよくここまで来られたもんだわ。
